title: The festival that opened in 1946
show: Today In History with The Retrospectors
description: The first Cannes Film Festival, planned for 1939 as a free alternative to Mussolini’s festival in Venice, was cancelled by the war and finally opened in September 1946. It moved to the current Palais in 1983. Cannes is 40 minutes from Nice by train.

episode: Art and Life on the Midi, Antibes, Picasso, de Stael, Matisse
